responsibility: This file implements the front end’s general-purpose statement and token matchers outside expression parsing. It provides low-level helpers for names, labels, operators, member separators, iterators, type specs, and statement endings, and matches many executable and declarative Fortran constructs including control-flow statements, SELECT TYPE/RANK, WHERE/ELSEWHERE, COMMON and OpenMP/OpenACC directive sentinels, building parse-tree nodes and tracking parser state as it goes.
same_name_distinction: Implements the parser’s matching routines and matching-state behavior for statements, tokens, and constructs such as WHERE, SELECT TYPE/RANK, and directive sentinels. Unlike gcc/fortran/match.h, it contains the parser logic itself rather than only the matcher declarations and shared globals.
